subject: Energy
title: Energy Colonialism
description: Learn Energy Colonialism in one minute.

hook.text: Rich nations caused most historical emissions—yet developing nations bear the worst climate impacts and energy poverty.

buildup.text: The Global North has emitted about 80% of cumulative CO₂—yet expects the Global South to leapfrog to clean energy.

discovery.text: Climate finance promises ($100 billion/year) aim to help developing nations transition—but delivery has fallen short.

twist.text: Some clean energy supply chains replicate colonial patterns—minerals extracted from Africa refined in China or Europe.

climax.text: Energy sovereignty—nations controlling their own resources and transition pace—is a growing Global South demand.

punchline.text: Who caused it, who pays—the central question of energy justice.

quiz.question: What share of cumulative CO₂ has the Global North emitted?
